categories.label: Food
categories.hint: Groceries, restaurants, snacks and meal-delivery services.

categories.label: Shelter
categories.hint: Rent or mortgage payments, utilities, property taxes, home insurance, repairs and accommodation away from home.

categories.label: Household operations
categories.hint: Phone, internet, digital services, child care, pets, cleaning and garden supplies/services.

categories.label: Furnishings & equipment
categories.hint: Furniture, appliances, tools and related repairs.

categories.label: Clothing & accessories
categories.hint: Clothing, shoes, jewellery and clothing services.

categories.label: Transportation
categories.hint: Vehicle purchases/leases, fuel, insurance, maintenance, transit and flights. Large purchases can make averages uneven.

categories.label: Health care
categories.hint: Out-of-pocket medicine, dental, vision, health services and private insurance premiums.

categories.label: Personal care
categories.hint: Personal care products, haircuts and other personal services.

categories.label: Recreation
categories.hint: Hobbies, electronics, sports, entertainment, television services and package trips.

categories.label: Education
categories.hint: Tuition, courses, textbooks and school supplies.

categories.label: Reading materials
categories.source: Reading materials and other printed matter
categories.hint: Books, newspapers, magazines and related services; school books belong in Education.

categories.label: Alcohol, tobacco & cannabis
categories.source: Tobacco products, alcoholic beverages and cannabis for non-medical use
categories.hint: Includes purchases from stores and licensed premises; do not also count these in Food.

categories.label: Games of chance
categories.hint: Lottery tickets, bingo and other gambling expenditures.

categories.label: Miscellaneous
categories.hint: Financial services, dues, legal fees and other miscellaneous spending.
